subject: Post-demo: FintechCo performance SLO checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@fintechco.com>, Leena Kumar <leena.kumar@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:30:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: FintechCo performance SLO checklist & next steps

Hi Sam / Leena \u0014

Thanks again for your time today \u0014 really appreciated the detailed questions from the Eng team. Per our demo, I wanted to capture the performance SLOs you called out so we have a shared starting point and next steps for the MAP (mutual action plan).

Key SLOs you mentioned:
- P95 tail latency for streaming chat: <= 250ms
- Average throughput: 120 requests/sec for text-gen endpoints (60-120 token median)
- Concurrent users: support 750 concurrent open sessions with KV cache warmed over steady-state
- Streaming/ chunked responses: server-sent events with sub-100ms first-byte for short replies
- Cold-start tolerance: < 500ms additional overhead for model warm-up in dedicated mode

Attached: draft perf report from today\u0019s run and an SLO checklist template. Please review and confirm if I captured everything correctly.

Next steps I propose:
1) Engineering sync (30 min) with your infra lead to validate concurrency model and streaming protocol (we can do Wed/Thu) \u0014 Rishi will lead.
2) Provide a follow-up perf run with token distribution matching your prod traces (Aditya to run with your sample set once we get sanitized traces).
3) Finalize MAP with decision criteria and timeline \u0014 target decision by end of month.

Can you confirm availability for the engineering sync and whether you can share a sanitized trace for Aditya to run the follow-up?

Regards,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: fintechco-demo-perf-report-v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2 MB)

Cc: Leena Kumar <leena.kumar@fintechco.com>, Eng Team <eng@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: FintechCo performance SLO checklist & next steps

Thanks Marissa \u0014 this looks right to me. Couple of clarifications:
- The 120 rps is for our public API-facing endpoints; internal batch jobs can be slower.
- For streaming, first-byte is most important for our UI; anything under 150ms is ideal, but we can compromise to 250ms as a hard P95.
- We currently have spikes up to ~1,200 concurrent sessions during peak auth flows, but sustained concurrency is ~500-600. We care about graceful degradation above 750.

I can get a sanitized trace exported by EOD Monday \u0014 will remove any PII.

Wed/Thu: Leena and I are open between 10:00-13:00 PT on both days. Please pick a slot.

\u0014Sam
Sam Jensen
Head of Platform Engineering | FintechCo
sam.jensen@fintechco.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: FintechCo performance SLO checklist & next steps \u0014 perf run details

Hi Sam / Leena \u0014

Thanks for the quick responses and for offering the sanitized trace. A few technical clarifications so Aditya's follow-up run matches your environment:

1) Token distribution: please confirm median/90/99 token lengths for the sample \u0014 if you can attach percentiles that\u0019s ideal.
2) Session semantics: Are your \"concurrent sessions\" pinned long-lived SSE connections (chat sessions) or short-lived HTTP requests layered by front-end? We need to simulate both steady-state and spike behavior.
3) Warm cache: do you expect KV cache to be pre-warmed per user session, or do you rely on shared prefix caching?
4) Networking: Any egress NAT or proxy that adds consistent 20-50ms latency we should include?

Planned perf run:
- Throughput ladder: 50/120/250 rps runs, 10-minute steady windows
- Streaming: test first-byte and payload chunk timings with 20ms chunk interval
- Concurrency: simulate 500, 750, and 1,200 concurrent sessions (SSE) with realistic think-times
- Metrics captured: p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/GPU utilization, mem/KV hit rate, cold-start times

If you can drop the sanitized trace to the drive link in this thread and call out token percentiles, I\u0019ll schedule the runs and share the raw results + a short summary report.

\u0014Aditya
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachment: none

Subject: Re: Post-demo: FintechCo performance SLO checklist & next steps \u0014 MAP & decision criteria

Morning all \u0014

Thanks Sam \u0014 that schedule works. Confirming next actions and decision criteria so we\u0019re aligned for the MAP:

Agreed next actions:
- Sam to upload sanitized production traces to the shared Drive by Mon EOD (FintechCo) \u0014 target: 2026-11-23
- Aditya to run perf ladder and streaming tests once traces are available \u0014 deliverables: raw metrics + perf summary (ETA: 3 business days after traces)
- Rishi to run the architecture sync with FintechCo infra (30 min) \u0014 proposed slot: Thu 11:00 PT (please confirm)
- Marissa to draft MAP and decision criteria doc and circulate for signatures (Doc in Drive)

Decision criteria (FintechCo internal):
- Meet streaming P95 <= 250ms with consistent first-byte < 150ms in steady-state
- Sustained throughput at 120 rps with p95 latency within 1.5x of demo baseline
- Graceful degradation above 750 concurrent sessions (errors < 2%, backlog handling acceptable)
- Operational fit: support for required observability hooks + SOC2 evidence path

If everyone agrees I\u0019ll schedule the architecture sync for Thu 11:00 PT and start the MAP doc. Sam / Leena \u0014 please confirm availability and the trace drop.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
